title: The Saree Run (Bengaluru Edition)
description: An iconic nationwide fitness movement founded by Jayanagar Jaguars and Coach Pramod Deshpande. Shattering stereotypes by running proud in traditional six-yard sarees and running shoes, celebrating sisterhood, wellness, and self-empowerment.
highlights: Chip-timed 5K competitive run with age-category podiums
Open non-timed 3K walk/jog for beginners of all ages
Free entry category for young girls under 10
Exclusive finisher medal, hydration stations, and post-run breakfast

title: DivyaSree Nandi Hills Monsoon Run (DNMR)
venue: Whispers of the Wind, Nandi Hills, Bengaluru
description: Run amidst the clouds! Karnataka premier high-altitude monsoon race climbing the misty hairpin switchbacks of Nandi Hills. Featuring a breathtaking 530m elevation climb, cloud-wrapped summit views, and rigorous mountain safety marshals.
highlights: AIMS-certified, chip-timed 21.1K Half Marathon and 10K courses
530m uphill elevation gain through cloud forest and switchbacks
Dedicated mountain aid stations, ambulances, and physiotherapist recovery
Monsoon finisher medal, hot breakfast, and panoramic summit finish

title: TCS World 10K Bengaluru
description: Our hometown race! Slicing through Cubbon Park and MG Road. Complete with club hospitality tent and pacing pacers.
highlights: Dedicated JJs warmup corral and pace-setters for 40, 45, 50, 60 min targets
Private academy hospitality canopy inside Kanteerava warm-up arena
Course reconnaissance and tactical interval simulations pre-race
Official post-race brunch and celebratory center photo sessions

title: Tata Mumbai Marathon (TMM)
elevationDescription: Sea Link & Pedder Road Rolling Incline
description: Asia premier marathon. Experience the electric roar on the Bandra-Worli Sea Link and Pedder Road with our organized bus charters and cheer points.
highlights: Coordinated Bengaluru to Mumbai travel and hotel packages
Strategic cheer points at Haji Ali, Sea Link, and Marine Drive
Structured 16-week periodized marathon training blocks
Dedicated post-race physio and recovery zone

title: The Malnad Ultra
description: Technical, steep trails through mist-shrouded coffee estates and Shola forests. Unforgiving elevation gains and pure camaraderie.
highlights: Night trail navigation training with headlamp simulation runs
Specialized trail fueling, electrolyte balance, and hydration protocols
Technical downhill running mechanics to protect knees and quads
JJs basecamp cottage booking and support crew

title: JJs Annual Monsoon Inter-Center Ekiden Relay
description: The fiercest and friendliest intra-academy rivalry where Jayanagar, HSR, Indiranagar, Pune and Kolkata battle for the champion cup.
highlights: Traditional Japanese Ekiden tasuki sash baton exchange
All center heads (TCH) fielding elite and open teams
Age-graded scoring formula so all age categories contribute points
Mega community breakfast and trophy presentation ceremony
